title: Intervenciones
goal: Read how the 1904 Roosevelt Corollary justified direct US occupations of Haiti, the Dominican Republic, and Nicaragua, and how Panama's 1903 independence was tied to the Panama Canal -- all decades before the Cold War.
grammar: Mientras tanto: dos historias que ocurren a la vez

items: Explain what the Roosevelt Corollary of 1904 claimed.
Describe the occupations of Haiti and the Dominican Republic.
Explain who Augusto César Sandino was and what he resisted.
Connect Panama's 1903 independence to the Panama Canal.
Use mientras / mientras tanto to track simultaneous events.
